newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: OUB Bank proposes a 1-for-5 rights issue.
newsitem.headline: OUB Bank proposes a 1-for-5 rights issue.

text.p: Overseas Union Bank Ltd said on Friday it proposed a rights issue of new shares on the basis of one new share for every five held.
The rights issue would be priced at Singapore S$4.00 each for the local tranche and S$6.91 each for the foreign tranche.
"To increase the capital base of the bank to support the expansion of business in the OUB group, the bank is proposing a one-for-five rights issue," a company statment said.
It said the rights issue price represented a 36 percent discount to the market price as of Thursday's close.
The group has shareholders fund of S$3.2 billion as at the end of 1996, it added.
"Successful completion of the rights issue will raise shareholders fund to almost S$4 billion," the statement said.
